posts.trend: ResMed India opens its first flagship sleep health experience store in Kochi
posts.context: Basic biological functions like sleeping have become monetised retail experiences.
posts.angle: You can spend a fortune on sleep gadgets but your brain still overthinks for free.
slides: They opened a flagship retail store to sell you sleep.

Sleep score tracker on your wrist.
Weighted blanket in your cart.
Magnesium glycinate on order.
₹40,000 machine next to the bed.
Your brain turns on at 2:00 AM for free.
posts.caption: Somebody you know has four sleep tracking apps installed and still wakes up tired.
posts.rank_verdict: The hook clears its throat about a retail store instead of hitting directly with the sleep item madness.
